text: BABA-induced resistance to *Plectosphaerella cucumerina* in Arabidopsis relies on indolic defences beyond callose-rich wall deposits. LC/triple-quadrupole precursor-ion scanning found a 160 m/z negative-mode ion primed by BABA only in infected plants; QTOF exact-mass analysis, confirmed against a commercial standard, identified indole-3-carboxylic acid (I3CA), primed upon infection unlike IAA and camalexin, indicating multicomponent priming. Separately, integrin αvβ3 marks stem-like, erlotinib-resistant breast, lung and pancreatic carcinoma cells; unliganded αvβ3 recruits KRAS and RalB to the plasma membrane, activating TBK1 and NF-κB — necessary and sufficient for tumour initiation, self-renewal and erlotinib resistance. Bortezomib reversed both stemness and resistance. A third study reports that a compromised intestinal epithelial barrier triggers adaptive immune compensation protecting mice from colitis.
